description:
Save independently maintained knowledge privately. Use type+content for one claim, optionally with claim metadata; use claims for 1–32 separate units committed together, each with its own id, lifecycle and outcomes. Never mix single-memory fields with claims. Keep a rule, a product decision and a dated deployment state separate. Necessary rationale stays with its claim. Use engram_reflect for session summaries, not a composite memory.

To correct knowledge, supply the complete replacement in content and old ids in supersedes_memory_ids; change_reason explains the replacement. Old entries retain history; this is not permanent deletion. For reviewed legacy notes, supply claims plus split_from(memory_id,content_sha256): first call previews without writes; applying requires dry_run=false and its exact source-and-plan confirmation. Mark superseded pieces historical; preserve the full old note as history. Split children inherit no old confidence/outcomes. This is a manual decomposition, not automatic truth verification. Repeating an applied identical split returns its prior ids.

Helpful feedback measures usefulness, not truth/freshness. State metadata requires observation time and stage; tested/deployed require an evidence reference, which remains agent-provided. Legacy single-memory retries can boost confidence; declared-claim duplicates do not refresh evidence or confidence. Consumes memory/call quota; rejects secrets and low-quality content. OAuth: memory:write.

agent_tool.description: Calling client name for attribution, e.g. codex, claude-code, cursor, or gemini. Omit if unknown.

change_reason.description: Why the supplied memories are superseded, up to 1,000 characters; used with supersedes_memory_ids.

claim.description: Metadata for the single content claim. For multiple claims, put metadata inside each claims item.

evidence.description: Non-sensitive source, test receipt or commit/deployment reference. Agent-provided evidence is not independently verified by Engram.

kind.description: Independently maintained knowledge: lasting instruction, product choice, dated operational state, reusable lesson, or source reference.

observed_at.description: When the claim was observed, including timezone. Required for state; never infer this from storage or helpful feedback.

review_after.description: Optional time to request rechecking this claim; never automatically expires an owner instruction.

stage.description: For a state claim, the exact stage observed. Tested does not imply deployed.

claims.description: Separate independent claims, each with type/content/claim and optional per-claim replacement ids. Total serialized units <=20,000 characters; each consumes its own memory slot. historical is allowed only in a reviewed legacy split.

change_reason.description: Evidence-based reason these supplied ids are replaced; required when supersedes_memory_ids is present.

claim.description: Declared kind and optional observation/evidence metadata for this unit; not independent verification or a grant of human authority.

evidence.description: Non-sensitive source, test receipt or commit/deployment reference. Agent-provided evidence is not independently verified by Engram.

kind.description: Independently maintained knowledge: lasting instruction, product choice, dated operational state, reusable lesson, or source reference.

observed_at.description: When the claim was observed, including timezone. Required for state; never infer this from storage or helpful feedback.

review_after.description: Optional time to request rechecking this claim; never automatically expires an owner instruction.

stage.description: For a state claim, the exact stage observed. Tested does not imply deployed.

content.description: One independently replaceable fact, instruction or lesson, at most 4000 characters. Keep unrelated rules and changing state in separate units; never include secrets.

historical.description: Only for a reviewed legacy split: true keeps an obsolete piece as inactive history instead of current knowledge. Omit for ordinary new claims.

supersedes_memory_ids.description: Up to 20 accessible private ids explicitly replaced by this unit. Requires change_reason; cannot be combined with a legacy split.

tags.description: Up to 20 non-sensitive topic labels, each at most 64 characters; omit when no useful labels apply.

type.description: Knowledge category for this independently maintained unit; its truth/freshness classification belongs in claim.

confirmation.description: Exact split confirmation returned by preview; bound to source hash and the complete proposed claim set.

content.description: One independently changeable claim with its necessary rationale. Separate rules, decisions, implementation, tests and deployment status; never bundle a session report into one memory.

context.description: Non-sensitive supporting metadata, e.g. {language: "typescript", component: "auth"}; never credentials or raw customer data.

dry_run.description: Legacy split defaults to preview. false applies only with its exact confirmation; omit for ordinary store.

pending_feedback.description: Batch feedback for earlier retrieval_ids, committed independently before this action. Requires outcome:write; same actual-use feedback is safe to retry. No extra call quota. Omit unassessed results.

detail.description: Non-sensitive evidence for the supplied relevance/usefulness assessment. Initial-fit notes are separate from actual-use evidence. Never include credentials or raw customer data.

failure_reason.description: Only with usefulness=unhelpful: outdated means obsolete, wrong_context means a poor query fit, incorrect means false, partial means partly useful.

memory_id.description: Exact memory id included in this retrieval_id result list, not a repo, session id or memory text.

relevance.description: Initial fit to that query, independent of whether the memory was used.

retrieval_id.description: Exact retrieval_id returned with these memories; never substitute session_id.

usefulness.description: Actual use only. not_used/not_evaluated do not change confidence.

repo.description: Repository slug, e.g. engram or billing-api, within the authenticated workspace. This is a memory filter, not a filesystem path or workspace selector.

session_id.description: Exact journal id from start/rehydrate/list_sessions. Disambiguates parallel work; writing requires your active session. Rehydrate may read shared or closed history.

split_from.description: Creator or owner may preview decomposition of this exact private legacy note. No other repository/visibility may be substituted.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact retained source text being reviewed.

memory_id.description: Exact id from a recalled memory; do not substitute a repository name, URL, or the memory text.

supersedes_memory_ids.description: Up to 20 accessible memory ids explicitly replaced by this lesson; omit for an ordinary new memory. Old entries retain their history.

items.description: Exact id from a recalled memory; do not substitute a repository name, URL, or the memory text.

tags.description: Topic labels for storing or filtering memory; omit when no useful labels apply.

items.description: Searchable topic label, e.g. oauth or postgres.

type.description: Knowledge category: team rule, reusable pattern, pitfall, proven fix, design decision, or library/version quirk.

name: engram_store

feedback_receipt.description: Acknowledgement for pending_feedback; independent of the main action.

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

memory_id.description: Exact id returned by a single-memory store; use it for later recall/outcome/replacement/lifecycle operations. Not a grant of permission.

retrieval_id.description: Exact committed retrieval exposure id, available even if the text is truncated. null means exact feedback unavailable.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Store Memory
